Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-136960  
Guideline Name 
Sohonos (palovarotene)  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Arizona (AZM, AZMREF, AZMDDD)  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
12/1/2023  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Sohonos  
Approval Length 
3 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) documenting ALL of the following:  
 
 1.1 Diagnosis of Fibrodysplasia Ossificans Progressiva (FOP)  


=== PDF PAGE 1633 ===
Page 1633 
 
AND 
 
 1.2 Molecular genetic testing confirms mutation in the ACVR1 gene  
 
AND 
 
 1.3 One of the following:  
 
  1.3.1 Both of the following:  
• 
Patient is female  
• 
Patient is 8 years of age or older  
 
OR 
 
  1.3.2 Both of the following:  
• 
Patient is male  
• 
Patient is 10 years of age or older  
 
AND 
 
2 - Prescribed by or in consultation with one of the following:  
• 
Geneticist  
• 
Orthopedic physician  
• 
Rheumatologist  
• 
Endocrinologist  
 
Product Name:Sohonos  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Reauthorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization

Page 1634 
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) documenting that patient demonstrates 
positive clinical response to therapy (e.g., reduction of volume in new abnormal bone growth)
